$comment: Texts of the workspace banners and of the “External access” e-mails. The source for packages/shared/src/external-notices.ts: the code takes the text from here and inserts the row with the function external_notice; the function itself knows no texts.
There are no links at all: no addresses and no name of the sign-in page — the person is guided with the words “open the memory workspace”. An e-mail with a link is the best template for phishing.

The substitutions are only {program} (the name of the program from the anchors), {time} (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC) and {network} (the /24 network for IPv4, /56 for IPv6). There is nothing else in the text: no e-mail, no full name, no codes.
banner — a banner in the workspace (null — no banner); mail — an e-mail (null — no e-mail). A new kind goes into this file and into enums.json#/external_notices.kind in the same commit.

banner.title: External access enabled
banner.text: You turned on access to the memory from the internet ({time}). You can connect programs from your own computer outside the office. If this wasn’t you, turn off access from outside in the memory workspace and tell support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: access from outside turned on
mail.body:
You turned on access to the memory from the internet ({time}).

If this wasn’t you, open the memory workspace from the company network, turn off “External access” and tell support.

banner.title: External access disabled
banner.text: Access to the memory from the internet is turned off ({time}). Connections from outside are revoked. Only you can turn it on again, from the company network.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: access from outside turned off
mail.body:
Access to the memory from the internet is turned off ({time}). All program connections from outside are revoked.

You can turn it on again in the memory workspace from the company network.

banner.title: New connection from outside
banner.text: The program {program} connected to the memory from outside ({time}, network {network}). Wasn’t this you? Disconnect it in the memory workspace and tell support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: new connection from outside
mail.body:
The program {program} connected to the memory from the internet ({time}, network {network}).

If this wasn’t you, open the memory workspace, disconnect the connection and tell support.

banner.title: Connection disconnected
banner.text: The connection of the program {program} was disconnected ({time}): its refresh key was used again — this happens if it was copied. Connect the program again.

banner.title: Connection key reused
banner.text: A repeated refresh key arrived for the connection of the program {program} ({time}, network {network}); the request was rejected. If you don’t recognize this, disconnect the connection and tell support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: connection key reused
mail.body:
A repeated refresh key arrived for the connection of the program {program} ({time}, network {network}). The request was rejected.

If you don’t recognize this, open the memory workspace, disconnect the connection and tell support.

banner.title: Many wrong passwords from outside
banner.text: In the past day there were many failed attempts to sign in from outside with your account (the last — {time}). Sign-in from outside is paused for it for now. If this wasn’t you, tell support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: sign-in attempts from outside
mail.body:
In the past day there were many failed attempts to sign in to the memory from the internet with your account (the last — {time}). Sign-in from outside is paused for it for now.

If this wasn’t you, tell support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: access from outside will turn off soon
mail.body:
You haven’t signed in to the memory from the internet for a long time. In 7 days ({time}) access from outside will turn off by itself.

If you need it, sign in from outside before then. If not, there is nothing to do.

banner.title: Access from outside turned off after inactivity
banner.text: You haven’t signed in to the memory from the internet for a long time, and access from outside turned off by itself ({time}). You can turn it on again in the memory workspace from the company network.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: access from outside turned off
mail.body:
You haven’t signed in to the memory from the internet for a long time, and access from outside turned off by itself ({time}).

You can turn it on again in the memory workspace from the company network.

banner.title: External access disabled
banner.text: Access to the memory from the internet was turned off based on the company directory ({time}): the account is disabled, has expired or has left the allowed group. For questions, contact support.

mail.subject: Prisma Memory: access from outside turned off
mail.body:
Access to the memory from the internet was turned off based on the company directory ({time}).

For questions, contact support.
